text.content: The National Cooperative Union of India, (NCUI) is an apex organisation representing the entire cooperative movement in the country. It was established in 1929 as All India Cooperative Institutes Association and was re-organised as Indian Cooperative Union through the merger of Indian Provincial Cooperative Banks' Association with All India Cooperative Institutes Association and later in 1961 as National Cooperative Union of India.

text.content: The Emirates Mars Mission, also known as the Hope Probe, is the United Arab Emirates' interplanetary mission to Mars, launched in July 2020. Operated by the UAE Space Agency and the Mohammed bin Rashid Space Centre (MBRSC), it uses three scientific instruments to study the Martian atmosphere and climate, aiming to provide a comprehensive understanding of its daily and seasonal changes.
